required_qualifiers: bovine species and source lot
chromium(III) tanning system and curing route
undyed unfinished wet-blue state
actual as-received moisture and dry matter basis
edge-cutting geometry and foreign matter specification
total chromium and chromium(VI) test basis and detection limits
actual biocides and contact contamination
jurisdictional waste or by-product status and authorised receiver function
receiver fibreboard feed acceptance and first-release lot identity
net wet mass excluding free drain liquid and packaging
gross formation and opening closing stocks with inherited burdens
source and receiving gates geography period and provider boundaries

product.name: Moist chromium(III)-tanned bovine hide before trimming
product.description: Receive already chrome(III)-tanned bovine wet-blue hides with documented curing, moisture, tanning agent and no dyeing, finishing or deliberate drying. Include the complete supplied hide mass and its upstream burden once, including contained water and tanning chemicals as composition subaccounts. Do not repurchase these constituents. The candidate native wet-blue bovine row has conflicting English/Chinese chromium oxide wording; no flow UUID is adopted pending identity resolution.

amount.expression: Report x_i for wetblue_hide as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Alternating current
product.description: Meter actual powered cutting and source handling. Manual cutting has an evidenced absence of this exchange rather than a fabricated electricity intensity. Native identity is alternating-current electricity at point of use on an MJ energy basis, using the property labelled Net calorific value. Voltage, technology, mix, provider geography, delivery boundary and line losses are unspecified; document the actual supply and losses once. It is not a waste-incineration supply assumption.

amount.expression: Report x_i for trim_electricity as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Retained moist chromium(III)-tanned bovine hide
product.description: Weigh the same lot retained for leather manufacture. Keep its gross physical quantity and assigned burden in a companion ledger at the trimming gate; it is not the reference product and earns no avoided-product credit. No native UUID is adopted because the same wet-blue identity conflict remains.

amount.expression: Report x_i for retained_hide as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Waste of leather, leather dust, powder and flour
product.description: Weigh actual edge cuttings as formed by trimming of wet-blue bovine hide, before later dyeing or finishing. This is the internal transfer to prepare, not an additional first-release quantity. Preserve full gross formation including later rejects and inventory changes; pair its material and inherited burden with received_trimmings. This native Product identity has an unspecified treatment and an at-plant production mix. It identifies only this separately weighed moist bovine chrome-tanned trimming stream here; the broad basename is not permission to pool shavings, powder, untanned scraps or disposal services. It supplies no moisture, chromium, yield, geography or recovery credit; receiver transport is a separate service.

amount.expression: Report x_i for formed_trimmings as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

waste.name: Rejected moist chromium(III)-tanned bovine trimmings
waste.description: Weigh only rejected chrome-tanned wet cuttings from this lot and record the authorised actual treatment handover. Do not use a municipal nonhazardous-landfill identity for this industrial chromium-bearing stream. Contaminant species and legal status remain explicit.

amount.expression: Report x_i for trim_reject as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

elementary.name: Water vapour released to air
elementary.description: Record independently measured ambient water evaporation only when present. This is physical moisture loss, not an inferred chemical reaction or an extra drying process; no density or emission factor is assumed.

amount.expression: Report x_i for trim_evaporation as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Waste of leather, leather dust, powder and flour
product.description: Match the exact lot, wet state, gross mass and complete inherited exchange vector from formed_trimmings. Internal transfer cancels on consolidation and cannot receive a second upstream provider. This native Product identity has an unspecified treatment and an at-plant production mix. It identifies only this separately weighed moist bovine chrome-tanned trimming stream here; the broad basename is not permission to pool shavings, powder, untanned scraps or disposal services. It supplies no moisture, chromium, yield, geography or recovery credit; receiver transport is a separate service.

amount.expression: Report x_i for received_trimmings as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Alternating current
product.description: Meter separation, handling, bin washing pumps and acceptance equipment where used; retain idle, start/stop, failed-lot and cleanup burdens. Avoid overlapping the source cutting meter. Native identity is alternating-current electricity at point of use on an MJ energy basis, using the property labelled Net calorific value. Voltage, technology, mix, provider geography, delivery boundary and line losses are unspecified; document the actual supply and losses once. It is not a waste-incineration supply assumption.

amount.expression: Report x_i for handling_electricity as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Tap water
product.description: Collect actual water supplied for cleaning empty bins and contact equipment. No washing of the saleable trimmings is assumed. Record separately any real added water retained in feed; it cannot inflate eligible dry leather or create first-release mass by dilution. Native Product is treated public/potable tap water supplied to consumer or plant, not raw abstraction or deionised water. The reference property is Mass/kg; its additional volume coefficient is not a measured density for effluent or leather. Use a local treatment/supply provider and measured quantity and state.

amount.expression: Report x_i for cleaning_water as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Reusable lidded high-density polyethylene bin
product.description: Record a single assembled lidded HDPE bin as actually supplied, in measured polymer/article mass, with lid and material specification. Count only new external procurement here; the upstream manufacture is charged once through the measured service-cohort ledger. Do not substitute HDPE resin or a 25 kg seed sack UUID for a bin.

amount.expression: Report x_i for new_bin as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Reusable lidded high-density polyethylene bin
product.description: Record actual external returns by serial identity and state. They are incoming physical articles with their remaining inherited burden/service ledger, not new procurement and not internal reuse purchases.

amount.expression: Report x_i for returned_bin_received as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Freight Truck
product.description: Record actual outbound deliveries, rejected-load returns and attributable empty-bin return legs. Distance is actual route distance; record loading limitation and the provider convention for empty running. A single provider includes its own fuel and actual gaseous/particulate emissions. Native Product describes generic road freight by truck, measured as goods mass multiplied by distance. It is not a vehicle purchase or an air/sea service despite examples of general freight in the comment. Truck class, payload, fuel, emissions class, region, loading and empty return belong to the selected provider. Include actual loaded bin tare and rejects transported. Select one complete provider per nonoverlapping leg; do not also add its fuel or exhaust.

amount.expression: Report x_i for road_freight as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Waste of leather, leather dust, powder and flour
product.description: This is the only reference output: first quality release of the newly formed lot at the receiving fibreboard plant gate, weighed net of bins, with actual moisture and chromium/contamination specification. Receipt inspection, resale, repeated release and return of a previously released lot do not create new output. Finished inventory containing this release is a stock destination, not another output. This native Product identity has an unspecified treatment and an at-plant production mix. It identifies only this separately weighed moist bovine chrome-tanned trimming stream here; the broad basename is not permission to pool shavings, powder, untanned scraps or disposal services. It supplies no moisture, chromium, yield, geography or recovery credit; receiver transport is a separate service.

amount.expression: 1 kg

product.name: Reusable lidded high-density polyethylene bin
product.description: Keep all bins accompanying gross physical consignments, including consignments later rejected or returned. Exclude their tare from Q, retain the packaging stock movements and service burden separately, and never treat the bins as leather co-products.

amount.expression: Report x_i for bin_gross_shipment as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Reusable lidded high-density polyethylene bin
product.description: Record empty bins returned outward to an external owner separately from bins already counted with gross shipment. The same physical outward article must appear on only one outgoing leg.

amount.expression: Report x_i for bin_external_return as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

waste.name: Rejected moist chromium(III)-tanned bovine trimmings
waste.description: Weigh this wet chromium-tanned cutting stream separately from foreign materials, buffing dust and effluent. Retain the original burden and actual extra sorting/transport/treatment; reversal of a previous lot does not become new feed production.

amount.expression: Report x_i for gate_reject as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

waste.name: Chromium-bearing aqueous bin-cleaning effluent
waste.description: Meter this one physically collected aqueous effluent at handover, including its measured dissolved/suspended chromium-bearing material. Link its one actual treatment provider; do not also model its contained pollutants as direct river releases. If discharge is actually direct, replace that interface with separately named measured species and receiving compartment.

amount.expression: Report x_i for wash_effluent as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

waste.name: Broken high-density polyethylene bin
waste.description: Weigh HDPE article discard separately and disclose adhering leather contamination and destination acceptance. Its waste UUID remains unresolved; generic clean-polyethylene recycling is not established by the polymer name.

amount.expression: Report x_i for broken_bin as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

elementary.name: Water vapour released to air
elementary.description: Measure actual evaporation during segregation, covered storage and transport independently of effluent and spills. Total chromium or COD is an analytical balance indicator, not a gaseous chromium or organic-species mass.

amount.expression: Report x_i for handling_evaporation as the already calculated section 8 single-normalization result; no further division.

product.name: Wood Chip
product.description: Received debarked virgin softwood chips, not agglomerated/resin-coated furnish or kraft pulp. Native Product identity is broad and Volume-based; record species, moisture, contamination and the exact loose/solid chip-volume convention. Independently weigh wet mass and measure matched bulk density for mass closure and supplier conversion; the UUID does not prove density or provider compatibility.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.name: Calcium carbonate
product.description: One complete calcium-carbonate supply charged to cooking-acid make-up. Generic Product identity has no stated assay, particle size, coating, geography or route; its preserved legacy Other-goods classification is not chemical evidence. Require supplier calcium-carbonate identity and carbonate/impurity/moisture assays; no assumption of pure precipitated grade and no duplicate Ca or carrier-water purchase.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.role: Purchased liquid sulphur dioxide for acid make-up
product.name: Purchased liquid sulphur dioxide for acid make-up
product.description: One net delivered liquid-SO2 supply with assay, storage loss and actual vaporisation/absorption utilities. It is not an air emission, recovered internal gas, sulfuric acid, sodium sulfite or calcium silicate. No compatible uncontradicted Product identity is adopted; do not bind an indoor elementary SO2 record or a Product candidate retaining an elementary-flow description.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.name: Fresh water
product.description: External supplied freshwater for cooking-acid preparation, washing, scrubber/cooling make-up and cleaning, separately metered by use. This native Product Mass identity has no source, purity or treatment promise; preserve each actual supplier/quality and match upstream treatment. It is not direct environmental abstraction, seawater, deionised water by default or internal condensate. No density is inferred from a separate tap-water secondary property.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.name: Alternating current
product.description: One actual grid-electricity supply for all included manufacturing operations with stage submeters. This binding is only customer-side CN grid-average AC at 35–330 kV; it is neither a generation/photovoltaic record nor Korean electricity. Confirm that interface before binding; other site/voltage/supply requires its own verified identity/provider. Record internal transformation losses once if inside the gate. Native reference property is Net calorific value in MJ; it establishes an energy unit only.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.role: Externally supplied water steam for indirect heating
product.name: Externally supplied water steam for indirect heating
product.description: Actual water-vapour mass crossing the heating interface for digestion and evaporation, with pressure, temperature, quality, enthalpy and supplier return/water convention. Steam is isolated from liquor by heat exchangers in this branch; a real direct injection requires separately measured water incorporation. No 11.0 MPaG grade is assumed, and a heat-service UUID cannot replace kg steam. No on-site boiler or duplicated fuel/provider is invented.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.role: Purchased aqueous sodium hydroxide cleaning solution
product.name: Purchased aqueous sodium hydroxide cleaning solution
product.description: Conditional actual cleaning reagent or compatible external gas-scrubber make-up; do not assume its use, concentration or entry into product. Record whole supplied solution once, with NaOH assay/carrier-water subaccounts and spent cleaning-liquid destination. Solid 95–98% and fixed 30% or 50% candidates are not interchangeable with an unknown solution.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.name: HDPE tamper-evident loading seal
product.description: Conditional one supplied formed HDPE seal if actually attached to a bulk outlet; weigh the whole article including documented retained minor constituents. HDPE resin, sheet, lining, mixed closure families and an unspecified packaging bundle are not this article. Manufacturing and post-release service consumption are separate. Bulk tanks/tankers are durable equipment with disclosed service allocation, never product net mass or a fresh tank purchase per lot.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.role: Residual lyes from the manufacture of wood pulp, including lignin sulphonates, but excluding tall oil
product.name: Residual lyes from the manufacture of wood pulp, including lignin sulphonates, but excluding tall oil
product.description: The selected broad residual-lye Product identity is restricted here to newly first-released clarified calcium acid-sulphite whole liquor concentrate: aqueous, unmodified, unpurified, actual solids, sugars, dissolved salts, pH and calcium counterion. Production mix at plant and unspecified treatment do not prove a calcium grade or provider. Its Chinese general-comment variant calls excluded tall oil 松香油; retain the official basename above and the explicit tall-oil exclusion. Never substitute kraft black liquor or refined dry lignosulphonate. This row alone is the reference output.

amount.expression: 1 kg

product.role: Washed unbleached calcium-sulphite softwood pulp slurry
product.name: Washed unbleached calcium-sulphite softwood pulp slurry
product.description: Joint fibre output at the wash/separation gate, including its independently measured water and dry pulp content. This is not the residual-liquor denominator or a bleached/dried market pulp. Keep actual wet mass, dry fraction, retained liquor/salts and destination; physical output is reported without an automatic avoided-pulp credit. Its exclusive later finishing is outside this liquor manufacture.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.name: Returned heating-steam condensate water
product.description: Actual clean condensate crossing back to the steam supplier, measured separately with return temperature/enthalpy and water ownership contract. It belongs to the heating physical mass/energy gate, not the liquor condensate waste. Reconcile input steam with returned mass, true vent losses, blowdown and stock; no assumed complete return and no automatic coproduct credit.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.name: HDPE tamper-evident loading seal carried with gross shipments

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

waste.role: Calcium-sulphite knot and fibre screening reject slurry
waste.name: Calcium-sulphite knot and fibre screening reject slurry

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

waste.name: Calcium cooking-acid preparation settling sludge
waste.description: Actual preparation sludge of measured carbonate/sulphite/sulphate/impurity composition and moisture. Do not label it pure gypsum or infer hydrate water from a generic calcium-sulphate CAS. Keep the real waste stream distinct from decanter sludge.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

waste.description: Insoluble material actually removed before concentration with measured entrained whole liquor and water. Keep it as one receiving waste stream with composition subaccounts; no additional purchase or duplicate lignosulphonate loss. If an isolated chemically distinct scale is removed, add its own row.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

waste.description: Actual condensed water from liquor evaporation sent to external treatment, carrying measured SO2/sulphite, methanol, organic-acid and COD/TOC subaccounts. Any internal condensate reuse cancels and any separate treatment/stripper is explicitly inventoried.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

waste.description: Conditional actual heating-water purge distinct from supplier-returned condensate and liquor dirty condensate; record salt content, temperature and receiver. A nonexistent purge is documented not applicable; input steam cannot be made to balance by inventing this outlet.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

waste.name: Rejected calcium spent-sulphite liquor concentrate
waste.description: Only actual rejected whole liquid sent outside for treatment; separately retain off-spec closing WIP and internal rework without creating new Q. If actually sold as a different product, document lawful function and price and create a separate Product card before allocation.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

waste.name: Discarded HDPE tamper-evident loading seal
waste.description: Actual broken/removed seals as a single waste type. Weigh and reconcile with seal stocks, gross outward attachment and external returns; internal reuse cancels. It is neither recovered-resin production nor a credit.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

elementary.name: sulfur dioxide
elementary.description: Actual residual SO2, CAS7446-09-5, after collection/absorption, with measured gas state and outlet-specific capture. The native Elementary binding is emissions to air unspecified, non-long-term; known stack/urban/indoor distinctions require the correct medium identity. Recovered internal SO2 and sulphite in wastewater are not this emission.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

elementary.name: methanol
elementary.description: Only actual measured methanol CAS67-56-1 released to air after capture; not total VOC, alpha-methylbenzyl alcohol, indoor methanol or an agricultural-soil flow. Native air-unspecified non-long-term binding requires disclosure of actual receptor and replacement when a known specific compartment applies. Methanol remaining in transferred dirty condensate is a contained subaccount. The catalog synonym list also contains sodium methoxide, methanol-water mixtures and functional-group/formulation terms; those are not authorized identities. Selection is restricted to analytically identified neutral methanol matching the primary basename/CAS, not those synonym alternatives.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

elementary.name: acetic acid
elementary.description: Only actual identified acetic acid CAS64-19-7 escaping to air; neither total acidity/COD nor indol-3-ylacetic acid or an aqueous transfer. Native air-unspecified non-long-term binding requires actual outlet/receptor disclosure and correct rebinding for a known specific compartment. No volatile-acid emission is presumed from concentration alone. The native synonym catalog also mentions sodium acetate, cellulose diacetate and formulation names; these are chemically distinct and excluded. Only measured acetic acid matching the primary basename/CAS is adopted.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

elementary.name: water vapour
elementary.description: Actual uncondensed water vapour CAS7732-18-5 crossing to air, excluding water condensed for reuse/treatment or returned to supplier. Native air-unspecified non-long-term Mass binding is not a purchased steam identity. Widely mixed water/isotope synonyms do not authorize heavy water; selected physical substance is ordinary H2O vapour.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

elementary.name: Carbon dioxide from calcium-carbonate acid reaction to air
elementary.description: Actual geogenic carbonate carbon released as CO2 during acid preparation, after separately measuring reacted carbonate, retained inorganic carbon and any gas capture. It is not fossil-fuel CO2 or biogenic wood-carbon CO2. Do not adopt a fossil-labelled UUID, infer complete reaction, or infer water formation without balanced measured reaction evidence.

amount.expression: Use this row a_j from the sole final normalization in section 8; do not divide again.

product.name: Alternating current
product.description: CN grid-average consumption mix supplied to the user below 1 kV; use only that geography/voltage/supply boundary. Its native Net calorific value property denotes energy, not fuel burned on site. Meter kWh then convert to MJ once. A different supply needs another compatible identity/provider; retain charging and charger losses once. Include collection-point compaction when performed, conveying, sorting, electric handling, hydraulic baler drive, extraction, lighting and all failed/idle/cleanup periods.

amount.expression: Retain the unnormalized numerator for this row and phase under cp_utilities_recovery; reference the same sole per-reference calculation in section 8 after conversion and attribution.

product.name: Freight Truck
product.description: Native Freight Truck is a Product freight service with goods transport mass*distance, not purchase of one vehicle or a fuel. Record every real load leg, gross transported mass including attached packaging, distance, payload, empty running, stops and contracted collection/loading scope. Use one compatible provider per service segment; its fuel/emissions are upstream once. Generic route establishes no truck size, diesel grade, country or collection energy factor. Add collection-point/loading effort absent from the provider separately.

amount.expression: Retain the unnormalized numerator for this row and phase under cp_transport; reference the same sole per-reference calculation in section 8 after conversion and attribution.

product.name: Tap water
product.description: Supplied treated potable municipal water at plant; not reservoir raw water, direct natural-water extraction or a fixed Hong Kong/Brazil provider. Native reference is Mass/kg; a secondary volume factor is not a measured density. Weigh or use metered volume and independently evidenced tap-water density at the measured state. This dry route uses water only for actual cleaning/dust control, not pulping.

amount.expression: Retain the unnormalized numerator for this row and phase under cp_utilities_recovery; reference the same sole per-reference calculation in section 8 after conversion and attribution.

product.name: Hydraulic Fluid
product.description: Native Hydraulic Fluid allows mineral or synthetic base oil plus additives; this card is the whole purchased mineral-oil formulation for the baler/electric handling hydraulics. Purchase once, never purchase its base oil/additives again. Native Volume/m3 is mandatory; preserve measured volume and independently measured formulation density for the physical mass ledger. Reconcile reservoir opening/closing stocks, top-up, change-out and leakage. No default density, replacement rate, virgin/refined route or provider is supplied.

amount.expression: Retain the unnormalized numerator for this row and phase under cp_oil; reference the same sole per-reference calculation in section 8 after conversion and attribution.

product.name: Baling wire
product.description: One supplied steel baling wire article used on OCC bales. Native family explicitly includes corrugated-cardboard binding, but does not set alloy, coating, strength, diameter, supplier or wire mass per bale; declare these and select a compatible provider. Exclude wire from Q; procurement and physical attached-wire ledgers are separate. This is P_recovery only; a purchase used in service belongs to P_service, never both.

amount.expression: Retain the unnormalized numerator for this row and phase under cp_packaging_recovery; reference the same sole per-reference calculation in section 8 after conversion and attribution.

product.name: Uncoated paper tie-on identification tag
product.description: One whole purchased uncoated paper tie-on tag for bale identification; record actual printed/coated composition and supply form. Purchased finished tag includes its manufacturing/printing upstream once; no separate procurement of embodied ink or paper. Attach by the existing bale wire; an actual separate fastener/adhesive needs its own card. Bottled-food/retail-label native candidates do not establish this identity.

amount.expression: Retain the unnormalized numerator for this row and phase under cp_packaging_recovery; reference the same sole per-reference calculation in section 8 after conversion and attribution.

waste.name: waste paper (unspecified)
waste.description: The Waste identity has unspecified name and no route/grade restriction; its 39249 classification is a broader classification placement, not a claim that this stream is mixed unsorted paper. Bind the concrete single paper stream named in this card with measured composition, moisture, origin, legal state and destination. Do not choose it by classification alone or use it as the qualified reference Product. Weigh the whole actual OCC consignment at the holder/collection interface; keep paper, free moisture, incidental tape, staples and other contamination in a composition subledger, not additional purchased inputs. Separate packaging tare and its own ledger; no new board purchase. Positive/negative market value does not change the native Waste type or establish burden-free input. First external nonpurchase attached wire or paper tags enter N through separate atomic receipt events under cp_packaging_recovery; preserve their measured wet mass and inherited vectors once outside net OCC/Q. A tare observation alone is not that receipt record.

amount.expression: Retain the unnormalized numerator for this row and phase under cp_receipt; reference the same sole per-reference calculation in section 8 after conversion and attribution.

product.name: Recovered (waste and scrap) paper or paperboard, of unbleached kraft paper or paperboard or corrugated paper or paperboard
product.description: This generic Product family is production mix at plant with unspecified treatment. waste.description: Conditional actual purge sent to external treatment. Record whole wastewater mass, temperature and measured dissolved/suspended species as non-additive composition detail; no separate environmental discharge is assumed. No condenser or steam return is inferred.

waste.name: Used lubricating oil
waste.description: Waste used petroleum-based or synthetic lubricating oil contaminated through use, at generation point, treatment unspecified, Mass/kg. Restrict here to the actual drained mineral machine oil; retain assay and one actual external treatment provider. The record gives no recycling, combustion, disposal or credit default and does not include oily water or cleaning textiles.

elementary.role: Residual wood particulate release to air
elementary.name: Particulate matter, particle size unspecified
elementary.description: Actual uncaptured wood particulate emitted to air with subcompartment and size fraction unspecified; record measured control boundary, sampling and uncertainty. Native Mass/kg defines no chemical composition, size distribution, stack height or LCIA factor. Its clinker example is explicitly only an example and supplies no wood emission factor. Captured fines remain separate Waste/internal return. Do not sum nested PM size fractions; use mutually exclusive fractions if measured and separately identified.

amount.expression: Use the sole section 8 result x_jc for this exchange from cp_air; retain unnormalised raw records and do not divide again.

elementary.name: water vapour
elementary.description: Water CAS 7732-18-5 in vapour phase emitted to air unspecified, Mass/kg. Subtract inlet-air humidity when using an exhaust moisture balance; cooling-loop and wood-water origins are subledger partitions of this whole emission, not additional water outputs. Native broad imported synonyms mentioning ice/heavy/isotopic water do not change this ordinary H2O vapour identity. It is neither liquid effluent nor purchased process steam, and its occurrence is measured, not forced from a single residual.

elementary.name: Alpha-pinene to air, stereochemistry unspecified
elementary.description: Conditional only on actual speciated alpha-pinene, CAS 80-56-8, from this wood/press handling. No amount or universal presence is asserted. Do not map an unspecified stereoisomer to a fixed (1S)-(-) native record or convert a total-VOC detector response into this species. Identify each additional actual gas separately with its own amount and destination; unknown VOC composition remains an explicit measurement gap.

amount.expression: Use the sole section 8 result x_jc for this exchange from cp_air; retain unnormalised raw records and do not divide again.

product.name: Alternating current
product.description: Meter actual electric storage/handling/loading/repacking work including idle and return inspection. User-side CN grid-average AC below 1 kV only; native property is Net calorific value interpreted here as electrical energy in MJ, not fuel combustion. Actual site, voltage, supply mix, period, transmission boundary and one compatible provider must match; the Flow is no electricity consumption factor. Attribute by original cohort and measured activity; use its original Q_c once, never gross dispatch or service H as production.

amount.expression: Use the sole section 8 result x_jc for this exchange from cp_service; retain unnormalised raw records and do not divide again.

product.name: Polyethylene film
product.description: Actual new PE replacement film only; the same CAS 9002-88-4 at-plant polyethylene-film native limits apply: verify polymer/thickness/grade/additives/recycled share and one supplier, disclose unrelated luggage classification, exclude PET/resin pellets/other package materials. amount.expression: Use the sole section 8 result x_jc for this exchange from cp_packaging_service; retain unnormalised raw records and do not divide again.

elementary.name: Water vapour absorbed from ambient air
elementary.description: Only actual post-release net sorption into the original cohort, measured independently; changes physical FG mass, never its original release Q_c. It is not an emission Flow used in reverse.

waste.description: Actual removed film sent externally, by original cohort; retain its own packaging stock balance and measured mass/destination.

amount.expression: Use the sole section 8 result x_jc for this exchange from cp_packaging_service; retain unnormalised raw records and do not divide again.

waste.name: Rejected untreated wood fuel briquette
waste.description: Actual still-agglomerated stored briquette lost to an external receiver. waste.role: Loose sawdust from damaged stored briquettes
waste.name: sawdust waste
waste.description: Only separately weighed actual disintegrated untreated wood sawdust sent externally, same non-agglomerated Waste at-plant untreated comb/rec Mass/kg limits as the incoming sawdust. elementary.name: water vapour
elementary.description: Actual H2O CAS 7732-18-5 vapour emitted to air unspecified, Mass/kg, assigned to original cohort. Native imported ice/heavy-water synonyms do not change ordinary vapour identity; no process-steam, liquid-effluent or density factor is inferred. Separate real physical moisture loss from allocation; original Q_c never changes.

amount.expression: Use the sole section 8 result x_jc for this exchange from cp_service; retain unnormalised raw records and do not divide again.

elementary.role: Actual handling dust emitted to air
elementary.name: Particulate matter, particle size unspecified
elementary.description: Actual airborne wood particulate, size/subcompartment unspecified, Mass/kg. Native identity specifies no composition, size, stack height, emission factor or LCIA factor; clinker example supplies no value here. headings.text: # Binderless wood fuel briquettes from dry untreated sawmill sawdust
## 5. System Boundary
# Binderless wood fuel briquettes from dry untreated sawmill sawdust
## 7. Allocation and Co-product Handling
# Binderless wood fuel briquettes from dry untreated sawmill sawdust
## 9. Validation Rules

required_qualifiers: Nordic spruce identity and source traceability
sawlog supplier gate and inherited burden
green untreated state
fine kerf morphology and sieve distribution/test
measured moisture and wet/dry basis
bark/soil/chemical contamination acceptance
no industrial drying/binder/agglomeration
first-release cohort and unique release event
net mass and container tare
opening/closing WIP and finished stock
actual separation/control route
site geography and electricity voltage/mix
coproduct status and exchange-specific allocation
physical destinations and background-provider compatibility
associated storage/loading/dispatch service boundary

product.name: Wood material
product.description: One physical supply of untreated green Nordic spruce sawlogs, with bark separately quantified in the received whole-log mass. The native Product flow has no fixed species, form, dimensions, treatment, moisture, route, geography or provider; its CPC 31 label is a broad locator, not evidence of a log or sawdust specification. Bind this exchange only to documented same-species green sawlogs. Attach forestry, harvest and source-gate burdens once; cp_origin identifies whether inbound road freight and prior debarking are already included. Do not add a purchased-sawdust background to the same wood. No plant drying, impregnation or lumber finishing is inherited by green sawdust without a demonstrated causal relationship.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.role: Electricity for sawing and supply services
product.name: Low-voltage alternating-current electricity
product.description: User-side electricity for debarking, sawing, edging, trimming, segregated conveyance, any installed screen/aspiration, storage, handling and loading. Meter production and post-release service phases separately, including failed runs, starts, stops, idle periods, cleanup and repeated work. Declare actual voltage, country, grid mix and losses/provider gate. The CN-specific low-voltage identity cannot represent a Nordic site; identity/provider matching remains required. No fuel, steam or heat exchange is implied by this electrical route.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.name: Freight Truck
product.description: Conditional external truck service only for the portion between the declared forest/source gate and mill gate not already included in spruce_logs. Record actual loaded and empty legs, payload, distance, moisture, truck technology and provider reference. Retain the whole service purchase; do not also enter that carrier’s fuel as an additional foreground input. Other transport modes need separate atomic service exchanges and evidence. The native Product identity denotes generic road freight service measured by goods transport (mass*distance), not purchase of a truck or proof of Nordic geography, a vehicle class, supplier or site performance. Its real reference unit is t*km: convert raw kg*km to t*km by dividing by 1000 once before attribution and the sole cohort normalization; already measured t*km is not converted again. Record the actual carrier convention for loaded payload and empty/return legs; zero cargo on an empty leg does not establish zero service burden. Include the carrier service once and do not add its owned fuel or emissions again.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.name: Petroleum mineral hydraulic lubricating oil
product.description: Conditional one entire purchased mineral-oil formulation for the actual hydraulic/lubrication circuit, including its supplied additives once. Record grade, supplier composition, oil charge and stock changes. The PAO full-synthesis candidate is incompatible and is not adopted. Oil in a sealed circulating system is not bought on every circulation; make-up, retained charge, drained oil, leaks and contaminated solid carriers are separate subaccounts. An actual emulsion, grease, biobased oil or other chemical requires its own atomic purchase and fate rows before completeness can be claimed.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.role: Municipal water for actual washing or dust control
product.name: Tap water
product.description: Conditional treated municipal potable supply at user/plant gate for actual saw lubrication water, dust suppression or washdown. Native water treatment and source vary geographically; do not use this Product flow as raw groundwater abstraction, steam or wastewater. All properties were considered: Mass is the reference; the secondary Volume coefficient is not a site density measurement. Record total supplied water and its measured fate, not only retained water. Lab oven drying of samples is a measurement activity, not industrial drying of the supplied sawdust.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.name: Steel saw blades or shear knives
product.description: One supplied steel band-saw blade used for actual wood blank preparation, within the native global auxiliary sawing/shearing cutting-consumable scope. This is neither a stone diamond wire nor a complete sawmill machine. Record purchased article mass, alloy/coating and supplier manufacturing burden; do not add its steel composition as a second purchase. Track installed opening/closing blades, sharpening, wear and scrap by service actually supplied. The native record contains no wear rate and establishes no supplier quantity or lifetime.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.name: Woven polypropylene bulk bag
product.description: Conditional one entire supplied woven polypropylene bulk bag used for temporary segregation or transfer; the declared final product remains loose bulk sawdust without a sealed retail package or compaction. Confirm fabric, lining and fittings of the actual whole article, measured mass and provider. A 25 kg seed-bag identity does not establish this bag. Count newly purchased articles only here; external returned bags are physical returns with their retained historical service burden, not another purchase. Internal reuse is not fresh input. Different container or separate liner/tie purchases require their own rows.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.role: Actual oxygen consumption in wood storage
elementary.name: Oxygen consumed from ambient air
elementary.description: Conditional ordinary molecular O2 (CAS 7782-44-7) actually taken from ambient air by demonstrated biological oxidation during storage. This is neither purchased industrial oxygen nor total ventilating air. Independently establish process/species stoichiometry or measurement, total mass, phase/cohort and fate; no oxygen demand is invented from a carbon residual. Include any real reaction water separately from pre-existing wood moisture using independent process evidence. Without actual transformation evidence retain the occurrence/amount as unresolved or documented absent, not an automatic reaction.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.role: Actual precipitation entering exposed wood storage
elementary.name: Rainwater entering sawdust storage
elementary.description: Conditional ordinary liquid precipitation actually crossing into the wood/handling boundary at an exposed stage. Record the measured ingress water and its retention, collected runoff or evaporation, separately from municipal supply and inherited wood moisture. Covered storage may document physical absence; weather data alone does not establish the amount entering a pile. This is not direct freshwater abstraction, purchased tap water or a second supply of the same water.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.role: First-released loose green Nordic spruce sawdust
product.name: Wood material
product.description: Only newly first-quality-released net loose sawdust from the segregated green Nordic spruce sawing stream, before chemical treatment, drying or agglomeration. Exclude bark, coarse chips, planer shavings, rejected fractions and bag tare from Q_c; measure moisture and size distribution with the same lot. Native species, product form, dimensions, treatment, moisture, route, geography and provider are unspecified; this Product/Mass locator is restricted by this complete description and required qualifiers, not a verified sawdust supplier background. CPC 31 is broader than this 39283 subset and is not a physical contradiction in a form-unspecified locator. Closing finished stock already contains its share of Q_c. Dispatch, reinspection and re-release never create a second quantity of production.

amount.expression: 1 kg

product.name: Sawnwood
product.description: Actual untreated rough-sawn Nordic spruce boards/planks thicker than 6 mm at the green, undried sawmill separation gate; weigh their own wet and dry masses. The native Product flow is Mass-based green undried coniferous sawnwood at sawmill gate. Its preserved historical “other goods” classification is provenance, not a conflicting treatment or physical form; the active classification is coniferous sawnwood. Do not include kiln-dried, planed or impregnated lumber at this gate. Later lumber-specific operations are exclusive to lumber and do not enlarge the sawdust numerator. This is an actual whole co-product output in the unallocated physical account, never multiplied by a burden share.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.role: Separately collected green spruce sawmill chips
product.name: Green Nordic spruce sawmill chip
product.description: Conditional actual coarse chip co-product generated by the source sawmill, separated from the fine sawdust reference stream. Measure whole wet and oven-dry masses, bark contamination and distinct particle morphology; downstream pulping is outside this boundary. A Volume-based Wood Chip record does not establish a mass-reference link or a bulk/solid conversion. Keep this physically specific mass exchange unbound until the provider unit convention and same-state conversion are evidenced; never reclassify chips as sawdust to fill a UUID.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.name: Fresh Nordic spruce bark
product.description: Conditional separately marketed fresh debarking co-product with evidenced function and actual common-gate status. Keep whole bark mass and actual price/status records. Mutually exclusive with bark_waste for each portion; the native Waste-flow bark identity is not used as a Product-flow sale. Internal bark burning is outside this electrical foreground route and requires separately assessed boiler inputs, emissions and supplied heat rather than a credit.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

product.role: Empty reusable bulk bag returned externally
product.name: Empty woven polypropylene bulk bag
product.description: Conditional physical return of that specific empty bag to its external owner after service; reconcile its historical use/ownership and mass. This is a container transfer with no co-product allocation revenue or avoided-bag credit. Internal transfer to the next batch cancels within the boundary and is not this external output. Attached bags sent with gross physical dispatch are a separate S term of cp_pack, not a new sawdust product or a second whole bag purchase.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

waste.role: Rejected clean untreated sawdust for off-site recovery
waste.name: sawdust waste
waste.description: Only clean untreated sawdust actually classified as waste and transferred for documented off-site combustion/recovery, consistent with the native “untreated, comb/rec”, at-plant Waste-flow definition. Fine particles captured into this stream are not also emitted PM or accepted Q_c. Specify Nordic spruce, green moisture, collection stage, rejection reason, wet/dry mass, receiver and treatment; native properties are otherwise unspecified and do not prescribe quantities. Contaminated preservative/adhesive wood, landfill-only routes, coarse chips and sold sawdust are not represented by this restricted waste row. Rework that remains internal is not external waste.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

waste.name: Bark
waste.description: Conditional fresh spruce debarking residue leaving the plant as a Waste flow, consistent with the native global at-plant debarking residue definition. The native source fixes neither allocation nor quantity nor treatment; keep actual receiver/status and wet/dry mass. Do not bind sold_bark to this Waste-flow identity or infer combustion and credit. Keep bark carried on logs and residual bark in chips/sawdust in the wood-component ledger so separation is not double counted.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

waste.name: Sawmill washdown wastewater
waste.description: Conditional one actual collected aqueous waste mixture sent to a documented treatment provider, including entrained wood/soil/oil as measured composition subaccounts. Record whole wastewater once; constituent masses are not additional whole waste exports. Recovered dry screenings already removed from the water are separate physical streams. COD, BOD and total organic carbon are analytical indicators, not a named chemical or measured wood mass. Direct environmental discharge requires separate real species and receiving-medium exchanges and prior route assessment; it cannot be hidden in this treatment transfer.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

waste.name: Used lubricating oil
waste.description: Conditional petroleum-based or synthetic lubricant used and contaminated through operation, at the point of generation. This native Waste flow leaves treatment unspecified; document actual receiver and treatment rather than presume regeneration, combustion or disposal. Weigh the drained whole oil mixture once, reconcile retained charge/make-up/leaks and its composition, and do not count a washwater-contained portion again as a standalone full oil export.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

waste.name: Worn steel band-saw blade
waste.description: Conditional actual retired steel band-saw blade sent off-site; record alloy/coating, attached contamination and receiver. Track remaining installed stock and off-site sharpening separately. The whole worn blade and its steel composition are one export, not two. No recovered-steel credit or assumed cutting life applies.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

waste.name: Discarded woven polypropylene bulk bag
waste.description: Conditional discarded whole woven polypropylene bulk bag of the same actual construction, excluding separately removed sawdust and oil. Record contamination and receiver treatment; no generic resin recovery or bag reuse credit. This is the W term of the separate packaging ledger and is not net sawdust production.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.name: particles (PM2.5)
elementary.description: Actual escaped wood particulate with aerodynamic diameter at or below 2.5 micrometres. Native Elementary/Mass flow is emissions to air, unspecified, without a specific height/geography; declare the actual receptor and use a more specific verified compartment if required by the assessment. Collect measured source/control-specific cumulative totals and form disjoint bins only for the same sampling conditions. Captured sawdust is material retained in product, rework or waste and is excluded here. Retain production and post-release phase/cohort flags. No native emission factor or dust-generation fraction is supplied.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.name: particles (PM2.5 - PM10)
elementary.description: Actual escaped wood particulate above 2.5 and at or below 10 micrometres. Native Elementary/Mass flow is emissions to air, unspecified, without a specific height/geography; declare the actual receptor and use a more specific verified compartment if required by the assessment. Collect measured source/control-specific cumulative totals and form disjoint bins only for the same sampling conditions. Captured sawdust is material retained in product, rework or waste and is excluded here. Retain production and post-release phase/cohort flags. No native emission factor or dust-generation fraction is supplied.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.name: particles (> PM10)
elementary.description: Actual escaped wood particulate above 10 micrometres. Native Elementary/Mass flow is emissions to air, unspecified, without a specific height/geography; declare the actual receptor and use a more specific verified compartment if required by the assessment. Collect measured source/control-specific cumulative totals and form disjoint bins only for the same sampling conditions. Captured sawdust is material retained in product, rework or waste and is excluded here. Retain production and post-release phase/cohort flags. No native emission factor or dust-generation fraction is supplied.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.name: water vapour
elementary.description: Actual H2O, CAS 7732-18-5, emitted as vapour to ambient air, unspecified; native reference is Mass/kg. The broad synonym list includes isotope/phase terms but does not establish tritiated water, heavy water, ice, a water discharge or purchased steam. Restrict this row to ordinary non-isotopically enriched water vapour. Separate wood moisture loss from dry wood loss and from liquid washwater. Evaporation must have an independent water balance or measurement; never fit evaporation and biological dry loss from one residual. No dryer, boiler, condensate return or purchased heat is presumed. The candidate’s synonym list mixes ordinary water with heavy/tritiated water and other states. Its correct ordinary-water CAS alone does not resolve that native ambiguity; no Flow UUID is adopted. Require ordinary H2O vapour identity and compatible native record before binding.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.name: carbon dioxide (biogenic)
elementary.description: Conditional actual species-resolved carbon dioxide (biogenic) emission to ambient air, unspecified, from the measured green-wood processing/storage phase; no onsite combustion is assumed. C mass = 12/44 of CO2 mass. Verify the native species/CAS and actual carbon origin, stage, receptor, control and sampling basis; a VOC or total-carbon indicator is not the mass of this species. Include only measured or independently evidenced applicable emissions, with unknown occurrence/amount disclosed rather than set to zero. These are real physical species in the unallocated balance; allocated burden attribution is a distinct account. The identity establishes neither an emission factor nor climate neutrality. Require ordinary biogenic CO2 gas, CAS 124-38-9. The candidate’s synonym list additionally includes dry ice, ionic and isotope terms; without resolving those form restrictions no Flow UUID is adopted.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.name: methane (biogenic)
elementary.description: Conditional actual species-resolved methane (biogenic) emission to ambient air, unspecified, from the measured green-wood processing/storage phase; no onsite combustion is assumed. C mass = 12/16 of CH4 mass. Verify the native species/CAS and actual carbon origin, stage, receptor, control and sampling basis; a VOC or total-carbon indicator is not the mass of this species. Include only measured or independently evidenced applicable emissions, with unknown occurrence/amount disclosed rather than set to zero. These are real physical species in the unallocated balance; allocated burden attribution is a distinct account. The identity establishes neither an emission factor nor climate neutrality. Require CH4 gas, CAS 74-82-8, with evidenced biogenic carbon. The candidate’s synonym list contains chemically incompatible graphite/carbon-black/formaldehyde names. Do not disregard those conflicts on basename/CAS alone; no Flow UUID is adopted.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.name: methanol
elementary.description: Conditional actual species-resolved methanol emission to ambient air, unspecified, from the measured green-wood processing/storage phase; no onsite combustion is assumed. C mass = 12/32 of CH3OH mass. Verify the native species/CAS and actual carbon origin, stage, receptor, control and sampling basis; a VOC or total-carbon indicator is not the mass of this species. Include only measured or independently evidenced applicable emissions, with unknown occurrence/amount disclosed rather than set to zero. These are real physical species in the unallocated balance; allocated burden attribution is a distinct account. The identity establishes neither an emission factor nor climate neutrality. Require CH3OH, CAS 67-56-1. The candidate’s synonym list also includes methanol-water mixtures and sodium methoxide; no Flow UUID is adopted until those chemical-form restrictions are resolved. The reported methanol species mass excludes carrier water.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

elementary.role: Alpha-pinene from actual green spruce emissions
elementary.name: Alpha-pinene to ambient air
elementary.description: Conditional chemically identified alpha-pinene emitted to ambient air by actual sawing or storage. Distinguish beta-pinene and each other real terpene as separate atomic emissions if present. The returned (1s)-(-)-alpha-pinene record fixes an enantiomer; an unresolved enantiomeric composition cannot be bound to it merely because alpha-pinene is detected. Retain measured speciation, molecular mass, carbon fraction, time, medium and control; neither total VOC nor a carbon-balance residual may be assigned to alpha-pinene. Unknown emissions remain gaps.

amount.expression: Undivided attributable A_i divided once by original first-release Q_c using the sole section 8 cohort calculation; physical A_i is unallocated V_i and burden attribution is separate.

headings.text: # Non-agglomerated green Nordic spruce sawdust from sawmilling
## 5. System Boundary
# Non-agglomerated green Nordic spruce sawdust from sawmilling
## 7. Allocation and Co-product Handling
# Non-agglomerated green Nordic spruce sawdust from sawmilling
## 9. Validation Rules
